aaliyah-puglia.summary: Aaliyah is a 24-year-old chef from Gloucester City, New Jersey, now living in Providence. She describes herself as confident, wise, and sporadic, and a life of sudden moves — Jersey to Miami at 13, then college in Rhode Island, then solo travel for work — has made her comfortable with change. She came for the title.
bullets: Chef who moved to Miami at 13 with little warning
Identifies with Yam Yam, hoped to play like Cirie
Voted out Day 3 in 21st place after her plan reached Brady
First known contestant raised by same-sex parents

alexis-levine.summary: Alexis is a criminal defense attorney from Atlanta who spends her days defending people against the government — work that keeps her thinking creatively from the bottom. Outgoing, thoughtful, and determined, she's proudest of ten years of sobriety and most inspired by her daughter, Lyla.
bullets: Ten years sober, and counting it as her greatest accomplishment
Iranian on her dad's side; hopes to visit Iran one day
Wants an ally who thinks nothing like her — diversity as strategy
Unwinds with gardening, books, and long walks with her family and two poodles

ana-sani.summary: Ana is a Toronto voice actress who has lent her voice to more than 60 animated shows, plus commercials, audiobooks and video games. She calls herself goofy, ambitious and chaotic, loves games of all kinds, and plays for her mom, a fellow Survivor fan. Her game ended on Day 5 in 20th place.
bullets: Honors degree in Political Science, focused on political theory and power
Named Linnea and Sharonda, covered it up badly, and got blindsided
Gym rat, pianist, coffee shop explorer and League of Legends player
Pet peeves: transition lenses, subway door-blockers, and cheaters of all kinds

brady-booker.summary: Brady Booker wrestles professionally as Bodhi Hayward, a job built on long days, little sleep, and reading a room. He grew up watching Survivor with his family and loves the outdoors, competition, and being pushed to his limit. He values trust above all, and credits his parents for building a life from very little.
bullets: Pro wrestler from La Salle, Illinois, now living in Knoxville
Did gymnastics throughout his youth sports years
Hunts, fishes, hikes, lifts, trail runs, and trains jujitsu
Says he is comfortable being uncomfortable

carter-krull.summary: Carter is a 24-year-old livestock farmer from northwest Iowa with a habit of starting things — a snow cone truck, a moving company, epoxy river tables in the shop. He credits his parents for teaching him to work hard and keep chasing. Adventurous, competitive, and big on keeping his word.
bullets: Co-founded a cross-country moving company named MOVE MOVE MOVE
Youngest member of Savu and youngest man on Survivor 51
Builds epoxy river tables, inspired by his house-building Grandpa Shaffer
Will send you home for chewing with your mouth open

cristian-chavez.summary: Cristian is a 26-year-old head of HR from Salt Lake City who calls himself fun, chaotic and loud. He grew up running homemade Survivor challenges with his dad, earned a master's degree at 21, and is a devoted father whose biggest inspiration is his mom. He loves competition and wants a partner whose motives he can predict.
bullets: Was an alternate for Survivor 47
Earned his master's degree at 21
Bakes, studies philosophy, and feeds ducks in his free time
Loves animals, hates worms, and has a very loud laugh

danny-kilby.summary: Kilby is a 30-year-old game designer from Mount Forest who calls Survivor the biggest dream of his life. He's a self-described wacky, chaotic, playful guy who met his girlfriend and most of his best friends through the Survivor fan community. He plays for fun first, but he's thinking three steps ahead.
bullets: First in his family to finish high school and attend university
Proudest of his mom, who earned her degree after he did
Wants to hear your "real laugh" before trusting you
Loves Blood on the Clocktower, karaoke, improv, Lego, and WWE

devin-way.summary: Devin is an actor from Lufkin, Texas, now living in Los Angeles, and he's simply thrilled to be here. He's charming, playful, and loyal, guided by his grandmother MoeMoe and a weekly D&D habit that taught him to roll the dice and figure it out.
bullets: Seventh of 13 siblings — something you'd never guess looking at him
Plays Dungeons & Dragons weekly; also loves line dancing and karaoke
Wants Rick Devens' joy, identifies with Joe's integrity and family love
Had the very first confessional of Survivor 51

eric-macksoud.summary: Eric is a mental health counselor who sees Survivor as a celebration of the human experience and a chance to test himself. He builds bonds fast, leans on emotional intelligence, and plans to be upfront about his feelings. Animated, charismatic, and genuinely curious about what makes people tick.
bullets: Community theater regular who makes close friends with every new cast
Trained in Muay Thai and swam competitively from age 8 through college
Passed his counseling licensing exam on the fourth try and still draws pride from it
Models his game on Domenick Abbate: charming, honest, calculated risks

jelly-loblack.summary: Angelica "Jelly" Loblack is a 29-year-old sociology professor who grew up watching Survivor with family and turned those questions into a career. She earned her PhD before 30 and sees her training in observation and analysis as her sharpest tool. Curious, warm, and ready to debate anything.
bullets: Afro-Caribbean and Choctaw descent, from Garland, TX, now living in Bloomington, IN
Won most comedic mascot at mascot camp as Webber the Bear
Her grandma — queer trailblazer and two-time breast cancer survivor — is her biggest inspiration
Pet peeves: bragging, black-and-white thinking, and loud eaters

jenna-doore.summary: Jenna is a Toledo wedding photographer who has watched Survivor with her family since she was seven. She's empathetic, determined, and energetic, drawn to the game for what it reveals about a person pushed outside their comfort zone. Behind the sweet, artistic exterior is a strategist who's been planning this for years.
bullets: Bought her first camera at 15 with babysitting money
Put a "Survivor Clause" in five years of wedding contracts
Gave away 154 original poems in exchange for people's dreams
Writes poetry, runs, and never turns down an adventurous hike

kristin-flickinger.summary: Kristin has been applying to Survivor since season one, and at 49 she's the oldest player in the cast. She works in crisis management and built her career serving the LGBTQ+ community, turning hard experiences into something useful for others. Determined and joyful, she's here for the adventure and wants a partner to get up to mischief with.
bullets: Grew up in the mountains of Idaho, now lives in Santa Barbara
Started an intergenerational cooking program for LGBTQ+ youth and seniors
Carries rocks in her bra, chosen by mood and what's on her calendar
Says she decided long ago to be her own inspiration

lewis-kelly.summary: Lewis is a 28-year-old farmer from Dublin who now lives in Puerto Rico with his wife, Andrea, in a school bus they renovated together. Becoming a US citizen pushed him to apply, and he arrives cheeky and self-aware, happy to play the fool while thinking a few steps ahead.
bullets: First Irish castaway to compete on Survivor
Lives in a school bus he and his wife renovated themselves
Calls lying a hobby and says snitches get their torches snuffed
Credits a trip to North Korea as practice for isolation and uncertainty

linnea-capobianco.summary: Linnea is a 25-year-old entrepreneur from Kearny, New Jersey, who runs her own business in NYC. She studied and worked in Washington, D.C., where networking taught her how to build relationships across differences. Rational, outgoing, and optimistic, she says yes to challenges because time is short.
bullets: Owns a successful business in New York City
Shoots street photography, does Lagree, goes to jazz shows
Gets uncontrollable laughing attacks at the worst possible moments
Inspired by war photographer Lynsey Addario, a voice for the voiceless

maggie-nestor.summary: Maggie is a West Virginia farmer, mom of three, and a 25-year Survivor fan finally getting her shot. She describes herself as joyful, intentional, and redneck, and credits her faith and the life she and her husband built as her foundation. She's drawn to bold, open, happy people.
bullets: Farms, fishes, hunts, lifts, pole vaults, and plays guitar
Has watched Survivor since she was 15
Identifies most with Parvati
First contestant to live in West Virginia while filming

mike-pinsky.summary: Mike is a 32-year-old baseball executive from New York City who has loved Survivor since playing it in apartment hallways at age 8. He carries his late mother's words — everyone has something to offer — into the game, and values allies who bring him information above all.
bullets: Proposed to his wife Becky using a Jeff Probst catchphrase
First kissed Becky on stage in A Midsummer Night's Dream
Home cook, pickup basketball player, and owner of a dachshund named Pookie
Pet peeves: misused words, overused words, under-seasoned food

ori-jean-charles.summary: Ori is a 27-year-old personal trainer and former college football standout who plays for his family above all. He's the first in his family to earn a degree, then added a master's, and credits his mom's sacrifices for everything. Confident, hardworking, and direct about what he wants.
bullets: Transferred from Louisville to Maine to be near his injured mom
Drove 8 hours home every weekend until the car blew up
First in his family to graduate college — now everyone has a degree
Was first chair violin in 6th grade orchestra

patt-cannaday.summary: Patt is a federal prosecutor in Washington, DC, who chases challenge and adventure wherever it shows up — boxing, skydiving, or a three-hour hike that turns into six. Goofy, loyal, and intense, he's looking for an ally who'll take risks and get into shenanigans with him.
bullets: Got lost hiking in Brazil, climbed out in the dark with friends
Names his marriage to his husband as his proudest accomplishment
Homeschooled by his mom; his dad served 26 years in the Air Force
Admires Amanda Kimmel's loyalty and Rachel LaMont's scrappy climb

rob-antonson.summary: Rob is a Rhode Island gate agent and dad of three who calls himself a city boy with no outdoors experience. He's playing to show his kids that stepping outside your comfort zone works, and he figures airport chaos has already prepared him for anything.
bullets: Coaches his sons in baseball, football and soccer
Reality TV junkie: Housewives, Traitors, Love Island, The Challenge
Oldest man competing on Survivor 51
First player to voluntarily attempt to vote for themselves

sharonda-cox.summary: Sharonda is an OB/GYN resident who grew up in a single-parent household in Pompano Beach and credits her grandparents for everything. She plays for her family and for kids who start out with less, and she's hoping to meet a bolder version of herself along the way.
bullets: First chair violin, played at Disney, and a lifelong NASA fan
Identifies with Cirie — surprised by what she can pull off
Wants allies who are loyal but can pivot five minutes before Tribal
Fishes, reads, and watches sports with her husband

thien-an-nguyen.summary: An Nguyen, who goes by Thien An, is a 24-year-old medical student from Fort Worth and the youngest castaway of Survivor 51. Quick-witted and warm, he's drawn to the raw, authentic side of the game — new friends and the outdoors. His parents are his rocks, and fairness matters deeply to him.
bullets: Former Boy Scout with early outdoor and survival skills
Back-to-back all-around intramural champion
Runs marathons on a whim, makes insultingly low Catan trades
Hopes to play like Kenzie: social, heartfelt, still strategic
